aggregation: Mean finite sessions within each mouse, then median across mice
smoothing: Individual-V1 HVA thickness; nearest registered V1 correspondence; contour sigma 0.03 mm and width sigma 0.05 mm. No extra export smoothing; polygon simplification tolerance 0.015 SVG units.
topology_repair: Raster union of quadrilateral strips from the common V1 reference to adjacent measured outer samples, hole filling, then longest 0.5 contour.
